title: BBC Learning English from the News 2024 — Quiz 3
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q21_neck_and_neck
elements.title: The runners were neck and neck halfway through the race. What does this tell you?
choices: Neither runner had a clear lead.
They were racing on different courses.
elements.correctAnswer: Neither runner had a clear lead.

elements.name: q22_by_accident
elements.title: “I opened the wrong file by accident.” What does “by accident” mean?

elements.name: q23_hide_in_plain_sight
elements.title: The spare key was hiding in plain sight on the front desk. What does that mean?
choices: It was visible but went unnoticed.
It was hidden under the desk.
It was almost impossible to reach.
elements.correctAnswer: It was visible but went unnoticed.

elements.name: q24_not_even_close
elements.title: “Was my estimate right?” “Not even close.” What does the reply imply?
choices: It was too early to assess the estimate.
The estimate was far from correct.
elements.correctAnswer: The estimate was far from correct.

elements.name: q25_scramble
elements.title: When the warning arrived, staff scrambled to move the equipment indoors. How did they respond?
choices: They delayed the work until the next day.
They decided to leave the equipment outside.
They followed their usual slow routine.

elements.name: q26_see_red
elements.title: She saw red when someone scratched her new bike. How did she feel?

elements.name: q27_mull_something_over
elements.title: “Can I mull over your offer before I reply?” What is the speaker asking to do?
choices: Explain the offer to someone else
Make a better offer in return

elements.name: q28_absorb
elements.title: The towel absorbed the spilled water. What did it do?

elements.name: q29_carbon_sink
elements.title: Which example best fits the term “carbon sink”?
choices: A fan that blows air across a room
A forest that takes in and stores more carbon than it releases
A thermometer that measures air temperature
A chimney that releases carbon dioxide
elements.correctAnswer: A forest that takes in and stores more carbon than it releases

elements.name: q30_weaken
elements.title: Repeated washing can weaken the fabric. What does “weaken” mean?
